Class Showed<T extends Card>

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.board.Showed<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the specific type of Card managed by this display
public class Showed<T extends Card> extends Object
Manages the display and interaction of a dual-row card offering (upper and lower rows).

This generic class is designed to handle different types of cards (Character + Events cards, and Building cards) that are laid out on the board in two distinct rows. It provides mechanisms to add, retrieve, shift, and register card effects based on their position.

  • Method Details

    • addUpperCards

      public void addUpperCards(List<T> cardsList)
      Adds a batch of new cards to the upper row. Called at each round when the deck replenishes the board.
      Parameters:
      cardsList - the list of cards to be appended to the upper row

    • addLowerCards

      public void addLowerCards(List<T> cardsList)
      Adds a batch of new cards directly to the lower row. Performed only during the initial setup of the game.
      Parameters:
      cardsList - the list of cards to be appended to the lower row

    • shiftRow

      public void shiftRow()
      Moves all cards currently in the upper row down to the lower row, clearing the upper row.

      The frequency of this shift depends on the specific game rules for the card type (e.g., Character cards shift every turn, Building cards shift only at the end of an era).

    • registerBottom

      public void registerBottom(NotificatorCenter nc, PlayerContext playerContext)
      Registers the triggerable effects (Strategies) of all cards in the lower row to the provided notification center. Cards are processed sorted by their era index.

      Note: If a specific card type provided by T does not possess an active effect, its Strategy should gracefully handle the registration (e.g., by being empty or null) without disrupting the execution flow.

      Parameters:
      nc - the NotificatorCenter handling the observer pattern
      playerContext - the context of the player triggering these events

    • registerUpper

      public void registerUpper(NotificatorCenter nc, PlayerContext playerContext)
      Registers the triggerable effects (Strategies) of all cards in the upper row to the provided notification center. Typically used only during the final turn. Cards are processed sorted by their era index.
      Parameters:
      nc - the NotificatorCenter handling the observer pattern
      playerContext - the context of the player triggering these events

    • clearBottom

      public void clearBottom()
      Discards all cards currently present in the lower row.

    • diffLastEras

      public boolean diffLastEras()
      Evaluates if there is an era mismatch between the most recently added card in the upper row and the most recently added card in the lower row.
      Returns:
      true if both rows are populated and their last cards belong to different eras, false otherwise

    • takeCard

      public Optional<T> takeCard(PlayerContext playerContext, String cardId)
      Attempts to locate and acquire a card by its ID from the display. The method searches the upper row first, and then the lower row. If found, the card is acquired by the player and removed from the board.
      Parameters:
      playerContext - the context of the player attempting to acquire the card
      cardId - the unique identifier of the desired card
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the acquired card if found, or an empty Optional otherwise
